question.text: A magnetic needle of magnetic moment <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>6</mn><mo>.7</mo><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi><mo> </mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></math> and moment of inertia <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>7</mn><mo>.5</mo><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>6</mn></mrow></msup><mo> </mo><mi>kg</mi><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></math> is performing simple harmonic oscillations in a magnetic field of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>0</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>01</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">T</mi></math>. Time taken for <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>10</mn></math> complete oscillations is:

solution.text:
Time period of oscillating magnetic needle is   T=2πIMB

=2π7.5×10-66.7×10-2×0.01 sec

=0.6647 sec

Time for oscillations, t=10 T=6.647 sec⁡=6.65 sec
